description: Get a congress member's disclosed securities transactions (newest first, last year by default). Shows tickers, transaction and filing dates, disclosed amount ranges, and the filed Asset identifying the instrument (such as stock, option, or bond). Use SearchCongressMembers to find member names, and GetCongressionalTrades for all members' transactions in one ticker.

endDate.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to today)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of trades to return (default: 50, max: 500, newest first)

memberName.description: Congress member name, case-insensitive (e.g., 'Nancy Pelosi', 'Dan Crenshaw'); use SearchCongressMembers to find the exact name

offset.description: Number of trades to skip before returning rows (default: 0, clamped to 0-100000). For the next page, add the returned row count to the clamped current offset; if the next offset exceeds 100000, narrow the filters instead. Stop when fewer than the effective page size (maxResults clamped to 1-500) are returned, or the response's total has been reached.

startDate.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to 1 year ago)

ticker.description: Optional stock ticker to combine with the member filter (e.g., AAPL)

transactionType.description: Filter by transaction type: Purchase or Sale; the synonyms Buy/Sell are accepted (defaults to all)

name: GetMemberTrades
title: Trades by Congress Member
